purpose: Collect inspiration for a cinematic robot character-selection experience without using reference screenshots as production assets.

references.title: Award-style cinematic product stage
references.attributionNotes: Source URL retained; screenshot is local-only reference evidence.
references.composition: A single dominant object occupies the center, with secondary information compressed into edge zones.
references.material: High contrast surfaces with disciplined highlights and deep negative space.
references.motion: Slow reveal and selection emphasis rather than decorative motion.
references.interactionModel: Choose or inspect the central object first; details reveal after intent.
references.intentionallyAbsent: No dense stat grid, no badge soup, no generic dashboard wall.
references.notes: Strong evidence for object-first composition and hidden secondary information.

references.title: Moodboard roster energy
references.attributionNotes: Pinterest used only as moodboard discovery, not award-quality evidence.
references.composition: Multiple selectable characters create a choice moment with a stronger selected state.
references.material: Layered cards, silhouettes, and selection glow used sparingly.
references.interactionModel: Pick one character, then inspect loadout details.
references.intentionallyAbsent: No product brochure copy before selection.
references.notes: Useful moodboard energy only; do not treat it as award-quality proof.

topTenCompositionPatterns: Dominant character stage with edge-context rails.
Roster cards that make the selected object feel committed.
Progressive disclosure: desire first, diagnostics second.
topTenAntiPatternsToAvoid: Using target screenshots as production assets.
Overlapping badges, labels, and card controls.
Generic dark robotics dashboard with stat-badge clutter.
